intro: Software Engineer building backend and full-stack applications, with a particular focus on backend engineering and cloud infrastructure.
about:
I'm Kingsley Korankye Baidu, a Software Engineer building backend and full-stack applications, with a particular focus on backend engineering and cloud infrastructure.

I started my career working mainly on frontend applications with React, but over time moved deeper into backend development and became more interested in how the systems behind applications are designed, deployed, and maintained. I've since worked with Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and AWS — building APIs, designing databases, and shipping production deployments with CI/CD pipelines.
story:
A highlight of my career so far was taking primary ownership of the backend and cloud infrastructure for a production application — designing the APIs and database architecture, and managing its full AWS deployment. I've also rebuilt a backend from Laravel to Node.js, and worked on projects spanning mobile applications, AI, and real-world data integrations.

I'm focused on growing as a strong backend-focused engineer — building reliable, scalable systems that hold up in production. I'm also genuinely interested in how AI can be incorporated into practical software products, and it's an area I'm actively developing alongside my core engineering work.
services: Backend API Design & Optimization (Node.js, Express, REST, GraphQL)
Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure (AWS RDS, Elastic Beanstalk, Amplify, CI/CD)
Full-Stack Web Development (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
Mobile App Development (React Native, Expo, EAS)
Database Architecture & Query Tuning (PostgreSQL, Prisma, MongoDB, Redis)
AI Integration & Automation (Alle-AI API, LLM Workflows)

projects.name: ClimateHealth Systems
projects.headline: Multi-platform climate-health early-warning platform (GreenRes Hackathon 2026)
projects.summary: Led a team to build a multi-platform climate-health early-warning platform as part of GreenRes Hackathon 2026. Deployed FastAPI backend to Render, Next.js web app to Vercel, and React Native Android builds via Expo Application Services (EAS). Integrated Open-Meteo climate data, Africa's Talking USSD, and Cloudinary.
projects.challenge: Managing build and release workflows across web, mobile, and backend platforms while handling offline storage fallbacks, audio playback, and live climate data integrations.
projects.lesson: Unified deployment pipelines and offline-first storage fallbacks ensure high availability for multi-platform early-warning systems.
projects.architecture: FastAPI backend on Render with Open-Meteo & USSD integrations, Next.js web portal on Vercel, and React Native mobile app built via Expo Application Services (EAS).

projects.name: Interactive AI Storyteller
projects.headline: Immersive AI storytelling platform — 3rd Place COMPSSA x Alle-AI Hackathon
projects.summary: Led a 3-member team to build a dynamic AI storytelling platform at the COMPSSA x Alle-AI Hackathon (July 2025), finishing 3rd out of 12 teams. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, and Alle-AI APIs for multi-modal text, image, and text-to-speech generation.
projects.challenge: Orchestrating real-time AI generation across text narrative, image scenes, interactive choices, and audio text-to-speech while maintaining high UX responsiveness under hackathon time pressure.
projects.lesson: Combining streaming text with pre-fetched media generation creates smooth interactive storytelling experiences.
projects.architecture: Next.js frontend app router integrated with custom Express backend endpoints wrapping Alle-AI SDK for text, vision, and audio generation.

projects.name: Radici
projects.headline: Property listing platform for Ghanaians living abroad
projects.summary: Contributed full-stack features to Radici, a platform built at Dext Consortium that enabled Ghanaians living abroad to list, discover, and manage properties in Ghana. Built authentication, authorization, APIs, and UI features with React, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. The project did not reach mainstream due to financial constraints from the investors.
projects.challenge: Building a trustworthy property listing platform for a diaspora audience while handling secure auth, complex property data models, and a polished responsive UI.
projects.lesson: Strong product-market fit and investor backing are just as important as technical execution for a product reaching mainstream adoption.
projects.architecture: React frontend consuming Express.js REST APIs backed by MongoDB, with JWT authentication and role-based access control.

projects.name: IP Address Management System (IPAM)
projects.headline: Production-ready full-stack IP address management platform
projects.summary: Full-stack IP address management system for tracking CIDR network blocks, IP allocation, VLAN management, audit logging, rate limiting, and request validation.
projects.challenge: Efficiently calculating next-free IP allocations across large subnets while ensuring atomic reservation, strict validation, and low latency under high query loads.
projects.lesson: Database indexing combined with Redis caching dramatically speeds up IP subnet calculation and prevents allocation collisions.
projects.architecture: Dockerized Next.js 14 frontend, Express/TypeScript backend, PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, and Redis cache deployed to AWS ECS and RDS.

projects.name: Student Result Management System
projects.headline: Dual-interface (GUI & CLI) student performance analytics application
projects.summary: A Python-based student result management system featuring a sleek CustomTkinter dark GUI with Matplotlib visual analytics alongside a high-performance CLI interface for batch processing.
projects.challenge: Maintaining 100% feature parity between a rich graphical desktop application and a headless command-line interface while implementing secure auth and multi-format data imports.
projects.lesson: Decoupling business logic and data access from UI adapters enables seamless dual-interface delivery.
projects.architecture: Python application layer connecting to PostgreSQL database, with pluggable CustomTkinter GUI and argparse/cmd CLI modules.
